name: RFL Knock-Down Multi-Drawer Wardrobe
description: Durable four-drawer modular storage wardrobe manufactured from high-grade virgin polypropylene and ABS plastic (dimensions: 66cm x 44cm x 102.5cm). Formulated with Insect Repellant Masterbatch technology to protect stored clothing from cockroaches and ants. Features a UV-protected glossy silver-accented front, easy wipe-down cleaning, and tool-free knock-down assembly.
